To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the concentrations in the tumor are higher after intratumoral injection than after i.v., that the concentrations in all other organs are lower, that the tumor concentrations after i.t. are 10--80-fold higher and that the tumor concentrations in the tumor increase by a factor of about 10--80 after i.t. application.
the concentrations in the tumor are considerably increased after i. t. injection of drugs.

the concentrations in the tumor and in the organs are considerably lower after i.t. application than after i.v., while the concentration in the tumor after local administration is considerably increased.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility to increase the concentration of a cytostatic drug in a tumor by i.t. application, and with the possibility to reduce the side effects of a cytostastic drug by i.t. administration.
the development of a method for the selective application of cytostatic agents to the tumor.
the development of new cytostatic drugs which are labeled with radioactive isotopes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
i.t. injection of the labeled drugs is superior to i.v. application in the sense of an increased drug concentration in the tumor.
the i.v. application of the labeled drugs is not the best method to obtain information about the pharmacokinetics of these substances in the body.
the tumor concentrations of the cytostatic drugs are considerably increased after i. t. injection, while the organ load of the drugs decreases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tumor concentration of the drugs is considerably increased by i.t. administration.
the i.t. injection of the labeled drugs leads to a higher tumor load than the i.v. injection.
i.t. administration of drugs is a promising way of increasing the concentration of cytostatics in the tumor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can achieve high concentrations of cytostatic substances in the tumor by local application, which can be used for the development of new methods of cancer therapy.
the i.t. application of cytostatic substances can be an effective way of increasing the concentration in the tumor and thus increasing the therapeutic index.
the use of a combination of 3D printing and a 3D printed device can be used to improve the accuracy and precision of drug administration.
